meta.name: problem-statement
meta.description: Write a user-centered problem statement with who is blocked, what they are trying to do, why it matters, and how it feels. Use when framing discovery, prioritization, or a PRD.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出以用户为中心的问题陈述，用于产品发现或需求文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要为产品功能撰写清晰的问题陈述
copy.tagline_en: Write user-centered problem statements for product discovery or PRDs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to write clear problem statements for product features

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据用户提供的信息，生成一个以用户为中心的问题陈述，包含谁被阻碍、他们试图做什么、为什么重要以及他们的感受，使用“I am...Trying to...But...Because...Which makes me feel...”框架，最终输出一句话总结。
howto.when: 当你在探索用户需求、进行优先级排序或编写PRD时，需要明确用户问题，尤其是已有功能请求但潜在问题不清晰，或需要向团队传达问题价值时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个问题陈述：用户登录时总失败。
使用问题陈述框架，描述小企业主找不到合适员工的问题。
say.note: Claude 会按模板填充，生成结构化的叙事。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude generates a user-centered problem statement identifying who is blocked, what they are trying to do, why it matters, and how they feel, using the 'I am...Trying to...But...Because...Which makes me feel...' framework, and outputs a concise final statement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when framing discovery, prioritization, or a PRD, especially when you have feature requests but unclear underlying problems, or need to align stakeholders on the problem's value.

say_en.text: Write a problem statement: users fail to log in frequently.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a statement with persona, barrier, cause, and emotion.

say_en.text: Use the problem statement framework to describe a small business owner struggling to find employees.
say_en.note: Claude fills the template to generate a structured narrative.
